product_promise: Universal iPhone and iPad client for connecting to a self-hosted Xuva server, browsing movies and shows, inspecting media details, and playing compatible local media.
source_changes_after_commit: Removed generated empty iOS scene manifest setting after SpringBoard launch denial on iOS 26.5 simulators.
Changed iPhone/iPad playback requests to prefer direct playback under the server default original_only policy.
Updated Svelte package-lock through npm audit fix.

promise_sources.claim: Universal iPhone and iPad media player for Xuva.
Pick your Xuva server, approve once, and the library opens to movies and shows.
Loaded library items expose Play, More Info, Movies, TV, Watchlist, refresh, and settings controls.

capabilities.user_goal: Find or enter a self-hosted Xuva server and reach a paired state.
capabilities.domain_model: Server URL, device identity, pairing request, and persisted paired-device state.
capabilities.completion_outcome: Paired client loads the server library after relaunch.
capabilities.persistence_and_recovery: Seeded paired state survived relaunch and loaded home on iPhone and iPad.
capabilities.stop_reason: No-discovery and seeded relaunch were captured; real approval path and invalid server recovery need current-build on-device proof.

capabilities.user_goal: Browse media exposed by the paired Xuva server.
capabilities.domain_model: Client home rows, hero item, media identifiers, route labels, movie/series tabs, watchlist sync.
capabilities.completion_outcome: The synthetic movie Orbit Proof appeared as Ready in hero and library rows.
capabilities.persistence_and_recovery: Paired defaults survived relaunch on both simulators.
capabilities.stop_reason: Home library proof passed partially; Movies/TV tab switching, empty states, unavailable server, and auth-expired recovery remain unproven.

capabilities.user_goal: Open a title and inspect versions, metadata, tracks, and actions before playback.
capabilities.domain_model: Movie detail response, media versions, playback decisions, watchlist state, related metadata.
capabilities.completion_outcome: Server logs show both simulators requested the movie detail endpoint after auto-open.
capabilities.stop_reason: Detail endpoint was reached, but screenshot and interaction proof were interrupted by macOS process exhaustion.

capabilities.user_goal: Start playback for a compatible local media source.
capabilities.domain_model: Playback start request, direct/adaptive route decision, stream-token URL, AVPlayer screen, heartbeat/stop state.
capabilities.completion_outcome: API proof returned direct route ready after the iOS preferAdaptive fix.
capabilities.persistence_and_recovery: Not proven in simulator player UI.
capabilities.stop_reason: The policy mismatch was fixed and API-proven, but player UI, heartbeat, stop, and progress proof remain incomplete.

capabilities.user_goal: Manage saved titles and server connection state.
capabilities.domain_model: Watchlist API, local cache, settings/reset connection controls.
capabilities.stop_reason: Visible controls exist, but runtime add/remove/reset proof is missing.

unmapped_promises: TV tab with real episodic series was not runtime-proven.
Watchlist add/remove persistence was not runtime-proven.
Settings/reset connection and auth-expired recovery were not runtime-proven.
Player heartbeat/stop/progress persistence was not runtime-proven.

decision_required.statement: No product-concept decision is required. Xuva can be a shippable companion client for users who run a Xuva server, but the current build needs more proof and fixes before release.
